calculation.description: Ranks assets for ten-day forward performance by five-day residual reversal, risk-normalized by 20-day volatility and strengthened when recent volatility rises relative to its 120-day baseline. All values use data available at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: 2025-2027 IC 0.05668 over 265 dates; 2028-2029 IC 0.00196 over 521 dates; 2030-2034 IC 0.04838 over 1057 dates. 2020-2024 had no aligned observations in this implementation. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.

provenance: Generated and validated by scripts/miner_1_20340119_volshock_residual_reversal.py using causal daily close data; forward returns are excluded from signal construction.
